title: AAR signs multi-year radome repair agreement with Airbus Avionics
body_markdown:
*Leaders from AAR’s Asia-Pacific operations and Airbus Avionics meet for a radome repair agreement signing ceremony.*


**Wood Dale, Illinois** — AAR CORP. (NYSE: AIR), the leading parts, repair, and software platform in the aviation aftermarket, has signed a multi-year agreement with Airbus Avionics covering the complete portfolio of Airbus radome repairs.


This agreement positions AAR as an Airbus-approved repair station in Asia-Pacific, excluding China, authorized to perform radome repairs installed on Airbus commercial aircraft. It builds on AAR’s existing Airbus proprietary repair capabilities for structures and components such as sharklets, elevators, rudders, and slats.


“AAR values our decade-long relationship with Airbus and continues to enhance our capabilities to support the growing fleet across the Asia-Pacific region,” said Nicholas Gross, AAR’s Senior Vice President of Government Programs and Component MRO. “This agreement represents a meaningful expansion of AAR’s OEM-approved structure and component repair offering, strengthening our position as a single-source provider for proprietary repair services across the region and delivering added value to customers.”


For more information on AAR’s Component MRO services, part of the Company’s Repair, Engineering, and Software segment, visit[https://www.aarcorp.com/en/repair/component-mro/](https://www.aarcorp.com/en/repair/component-mro/) .


**About AAR**
AAR is a leading global aerospace and defense aftermarket solutions company with operations in over 20 countries. Headquartered in the Chicago area, AAR supports commercial and government customers through three primary operating segments: Parts Supply; Repair, Engineering, and Software; and Government Solutions. Additional information can be found at[aarcorp.com](https://www.aarcorp.com/en/) .
